title: Down and Back
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：down　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 down 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Down, in 1974 the fisherman carried the net at the pier, and everybody in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: the fisherman had carried the net ② down before dawn, and nobody had asked a single question. The fisherman had come to the harbour two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the harbour he had left behind him.

The logbook for July 1968 puts it plainer. The net was ③ down, and the boatman who kept it wrote of the net ④ down in the same line; nothing in the harbour was ever left down for long in those days. The boatman wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ down, and ⑥ Down came the boatman who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the harbour had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1981 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was that the net be landed ⑦ down at the pier, and that everybody be ⑧ down before the July rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried down.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1984 she carried the net ⑨ down in public when nobody else would, and ⑩ Down, she said in 1986, that was the part the harbour never forgot; the logbook still speaks of it down. She kept the net in the same pier for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the harbour never forgot how down it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 向下（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the net down，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 向下（作表语，说明处所或去向：the net was down）
C. adv. 在下面（置于句首：Down, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在下面（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the net down）
E. adv. 在下面（作介词宾语：from down）
F. adv. 在下面（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Down came the boatman）
G. adv. 向下（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be landed down at the pier）
H. adv. 向下（be down 说明所在或去向：everybody be down before the rains）

answers.why: down 意为“在下面”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Down, in 1974 …。
down 意为“向下”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the net down。
down 意为“向下”，此处作表语说明那件小小的渔网的去向或所在：was down。
down 意为“在下面”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the net down。
down 意为“在下面”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from down。
down 意为“在下面”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Down came the boatman。
down 意为“向下”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be landed down at the pier。
down 意为“向下”，be down 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
down 意为“向下”，1984 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬下那件小小的渔网，副词置于句末。
down 意为“在下面”，母亲 1986 年那句话以地点状语开头：Down, …。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，渔人在码头搬下那件小小的渔网；渔港里人人都说那是头一回。（Down, …）
渔人已经把那件小小的渔网搬下向下。（… down …）
那件小小的渔网当时就在向下。（was down）
航海日志那一行写的是向下的那件小小的渔网。（the net down）
叔叔是从向下回来的。（from down）
记录要求那件小小的渔网在码头被起向下。（be landed down）
